cases.message: The featureflags "flags-refusal" is invalid: : ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'flagd-flags' with binding 'flagd-flags' denied request: flags is the only FeatureFlag in flagd

The featureflags "flags" is invalid: : ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'flagd-flags' with binding 'flagd-flags' denied request: flags is never deleted: flagd would keep serving the last flags it read. To turn a flag off, change it in flags
